messages.text: The issue is clear: when the input has no dash (e.g., `"7"`), `split("-")` returns `["7"]`, so `to` is `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. The fix is to handle the single-number case.

response.text: Both tests pass now. The fix was in `parse-range.mjs`: when the input text contains no dash (e.g., `"7"`), `split("-")` returns an array with only one element, making `to` undefined. The fix sets `to` to the same value as `from` when `to` is undefined, so a single number is treated as a span from that number to itself.
